headline: UN talks on autonomous weapons conclude with commitment to adopt rules by 2028
summary: UN negotiations regarding lethal autonomous weapons ended in Geneva with a pledge to establish regulatory rules within two years, despite opposition from Russia.
why: International arms control agreements shape long-term procurement and development standards for global defense technology suppliers.

impacts.name: Defense & Aerospace
impacts.why: Pledges to regulate autonomous target engagement could impact defense development programs.
